audit.whatIsWrong: Tahm Kench has no ability named "Flay" — it does not exist in his kit (P An Acquired Taste, Q Tongue Lash, W Abyssal Dive, E Thick Skin, R Devour). It's fabricated in whys[3], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, mid, and late. Several of those spots also mislabel Devour as his W when it is his R. breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown number, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad lines copy-pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: enemyKit lists only 5 real abilities and Devour is explicitly slot R (cd 0, stack-gated) not W. Abyssal Dive (W, cd 21-17s) is his only knockup/engage — that's what the text meant by a peel/knockup tool.
audit.corrected: See edits: fabricated Flay replaced with the real ability (Abyssal Dive or Thick Skin per context), Devour relabeled (R), breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real W/R timing, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to stop copying tradeGood/tradeBad.

edits.before: At 4-5 it evens as Devour and Flay give Tahm real peel.
edits.after: At 4-5 it evens as Abyssal Dive (W) and Thick Skin give Tahm real peel.

edits.after: Skill matchup: his Devour save and Abyssal Dive knockups make him a strong peel support, so fights hinge on whether you can burst before he body-blocks or eats the target.

edits.before: At 4-5 it evens as his Devour peel and Flay come online, but level 6 swings back to you: Pop Blossom is a fast, un-interruptable all-in that can kill his ADC before he reacts, especially if his W is down. Coordinate the dive with your ADC and force it in the Devour-cooldown window. Ward the flanks — his W Abyssal Dive roam is his main way to generate picks elsewhere.
edits.after: At 4-5 it evens as his Devour peel and Abyssal Dive dives come online, but level 6 swings back to you: Pop Blossom is a fast, un-interruptable all-in that can kill his ADC before he reacts, especially if his W is down. Coordinate the dive with your ADC and force it while he lacks 3 stacks to Devour. Ward the flanks — his W Abyssal Dive roam is his main way to generate picks elsewhere.

edits.before: With items it becomes a skill matchup: Tahm is one of the best peel supports, eating his carry out of your Pop Blossom and knocking you up with Flay. Fights come down to whether you can burst the target before he body-blocks or Devours it. Force engages when his W is on cooldown and pick off targets he can't reach.
edits.after: With items it becomes a skill matchup: Tahm is one of the best peel supports, eating his carry out of your Pop Blossom and knocking you up with Abyssal Dive (W). Fights come down to whether you can burst the target before he body-blocks or Devours it. Force engages when his W is on cooldown and pick off targets he can't reach.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Shapesplitter answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive (W) is down 21s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5 — his only engage and escape; all-in only while it's down. - Devour (R) isn't on a real cooldown — it needs 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from Tongue Lash or autos, so track his stacks, not a timer. - Spend your own R on swing moments only.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.
edits.after: Root once he's committed — Tongue Lash needs 3 stacks to stun, so early hits are only slows.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: Don't trade after he flashes in — Thick Skin banks that damage and Devour erases your kill.
